error.passage: xcl:MH_1_2_11_Agathangelos ed. page 1429 - PDF page 135 (word id 23655) (w2/3)
error.correct_reading: ծփանք 'surge, waves' (gen. pl.), from ծփեմ 'to toss, surge'; not ծունր 'knee'
error.evidence: Context: the sea that does not pass its bound 'with the surge of its raging waves' (ի սահանս ծփանաց ... ալեացն); no knee in the passage.

error.passage: xcl:MH_1_2_11_Agathangelos ed. page 1429 - PDF page 135 (word id 23655) (w2/3)
error.correct_reading: ալիք 'waves' (gen. pl. ալեաց + article -ն); no connection with the PIE word for elbow/forearm
error.evidence: Parallel to ծփանաց in the same phrase about the raging sea; the mapping produced false 'elbow' matches with ON ǫlbogi, Gk ὠλένη, Skt aratni in BS-2e541.

error.correct_reading: lín 'net' (here a silver net hanging from the sky, Immram Máele Dúin), from *līno- 'flax' (cf. Lat. līnum, Gk λίνον); not *leyH- 'pour'
error.evidence: Context: the curach sails under a mesh of the net and Diurán strikes the net with his spear.

error.correct_reading: l. = libra 'pound' (weight); libra has no accepted derivation from *leyH- 'pour'
error.evidence: Cato's recipe 'farinae siligineae l. II'; the mapping links a weight abbreviation with Russian пролить.
